description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential opportunity is ideal for a visionary leader dedicated to upholding the highest standards of patient care and operational excellence. You will be instrumental in guiding our facility's strategic direction, ensuring regulatory compliance, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.

As the LNHA, you will oversee all aspects of facility operations, including clinical services, financial management, and human resources. This role offers a chance to make a significant impact within a supportive and forward-thinking organization. We are looking for a leader who can inspire teams, drive quality outcomes, and maintain a strong commitment to community engagement. Compensation for this vital role is competitive, reflecting your expertise and leadership capabilities.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA or in a similar leadership capacity within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
Proven track record in financial management, operational oversight, and staff development.
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience.
